name: HYDRA-UMC-STUDIO
notes: Web control dashboard with 3D multi-robot visualization, talking to HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own API. GamepadController.tsx's real-time actions (joint/table jog, E-STOP, START/STOP, speed) now fire the atomic sendRobotCommand()/POST /api/robot/:id/command path instead of the 500ms-debounced settings save, matching every other real-time control surface in RobotDetail.tsx; jointLimitsFor() moved to the shared examples/robotKinematicsDispatch.ts so both reuse the same per-model joint-limit clamping.
